response.original_title: [Complete-Dispute] How to Dispute a Norwegian Cruise Line Charge or Booking Issue
response.overview: You can reach Virgin Voyages customer service for billing, booking, or dispute inquiries at Virgin Voyages Contact Us or by calling +1-866-254-7549 in the US and Canada.Contact Details & Hours US & Canada Phone: +1-866-254-7549 Hours: Monday – Sunday, 5:00 AM – 1:00 AM (EST) UK Phone: +44 120 420 8151 Email Support: sailorservices@virginvoyages.com Tips for Resolving Disputes Billing / Invoice Issues: Users on Reddit agree that you should request an escalation to Red Glove Service through standard Sailor Services if you are dealing with major invoice discrepancies or charge disputes +1-866-254-7549. Best Time to Call: Call early in the morning right when lines open to minimize wait times.
